item.description:
More focused note editing and clearer action controls.
- Use the outlined pencil to edit a note. An amber outline marks the editor, with the original timestamp on the left and Cancel and Save on the right. - Copy, Edit, and Delete stay hidden while editing. Saving keeps the note’s original date and position; Cancel discards the draft. - Submitting a new note closes any open editors and discards their unsaved drafts. - Cancel and Save now have compact, matching hover states. - Entry actions across Clipboard, Screenshots, and Notes use Cubby’s custom tooltips, with a short delay and placement below each icon.
Choose **Check for Updates…** in Cubby’s three-dot menu to install this release. Users on the original Cubby 1.0 need to download and install the DMG manually once.
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

A warmer Cubby, with smoother everyday interactions.
- Edit notes directly in the feed. Changes save automatically as you type, keeping the original creation date and position. - Hovering over the note composer now shows a text cursor. - Clicking the trash button on a selected screenshot deletes the whole selected group. Undo restores the group. - Scrollbars stay hidden when there is nothing to scroll. - Text and controls use a warm dark-brown palette. - Screenshot capture ignores hidden temporary files and waits for complete images, preventing phantom cards. Repeated file events no longer delete an existing screenshot's backing file. - A new drag-to-Applications installer features Cubby's Hanken Grotesk typeface and a trail of bear paw prints.
Choose **Check for Updates…** in Cubby's three-dot menu to install this release. Users on the original Cubby 1.0 need to download and install the DMG manually once.
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

You can now completely quit Cubby from its three-dot menu.
- Choose **Quit Cubby** at the bottom of the menu to close the app and remove its menu bar icon. - Pending changes are saved before Cubby exits. - Once Cubby has quit, you can move the app from Applications to the Trash.
Quitting or deleting the app does not erase your saved content or preferences.
If you have Cubby 1.0.1, choose **Check for Updates…** in the three-dot menu to install this release. Users on the original 1.0 release need to download and install the DMG manually once.
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
